channels.name: CXL.io
channels.purpose: Non-coherent I/O / config / enumeration / DMA / register I/O.
channels.active_levels: PCIe-equivalent packet stream over Flex Bus

channels.name: CXL.mem M2S Req
channels.purpose: Host read/inval request to device memory.

channels.name: Flex Bus TXp/TXn, RXp/RXn
channels.purpose: Shared PCIe PHY carrying all multiplexed sub-protocols.

logical_signaling_levels.name: CXL.io packet stream
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: PCIe-equivalent TLP/DLLP traffic on the Flex Bus.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Coherent Flit
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: 68-byte (1.x/2.0) or 256-byte (3.0) Flit carrying CXL.cache/CXL.mem channel messages.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Electrical Idle
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Inherited PCIe Electrical Idle when no symbol stream is driven.

global_signals.name: REFCLK
global_signals.purpose: 100 MHz reference clock (inherited from PCIe Flex Bus).

dependency_graph.common_rule: CXL.cache + CXL.mem share one common link/transaction layer, distinct from the CXL.io link/transaction layer. An ARB/MUX block multiplexes the two stacks each Flit before the shared PCIe PHY. All three sub-protocols ride one physical Flex Bus link.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Coherent CXL.cache/CXL.mem traffic requires: (1) Flex Bus negotiated to CXL mode, (2) CXL.io enumeration complete, (3) HDM Decoders programmed + CXL.cache/CXL.mem enabled in DVSEC, (4) ARB/MUX active. Asymmetric coherence means the host memory controller is the sole cache agent.

handshake_pairs.name: D2H-Req / H2D-Rsp
handshake_pairs.rule: Device caches host memory; host returns GO + data (CXL.cache).

handshake_pairs.name: H2D-Snoop / D2H-Rsp
handshake_pairs.rule: Host snoops device cache; device responds with line state (CXL.cache).

handshake_pairs.name: M2S-Req / S2M-Rsp
handshake_pairs.rule: Host accesses device memory; device returns NDR/DRS (CXL.mem).

handshake_pairs.name: BISnp / BIRsp
handshake_pairs.rule: CXL 3.0 back-invalidation of host-cached copies after device modifies local memory.

handshake_pairs.name: FlexBus-AltProtocol
handshake_pairs.rule: Negotiate CXL vs PCIe + CXL version during link training.

ordering_rules.coherence_ordering: Coherence is enforced by the host home agent; D2H/H2D and M2S/S2M message ordering follows the CXL coherence protocol.
ordering_rules.subprotocol_independence: CXL.io ordering is PCIe producer-consumer; CXL.cache/CXL.mem ordering is governed by the coherence protocol, independent of CXL.io.
ordering_rules.mux_fairness: ARB/MUX provides fair per-Flit arbitration between CXL.io and CXL.cache/CXL.mem.
